notes.title: Stream
notes.content:
The Survival Instinct developer will be broadcast live at Next Fest on Monday [b]June 21 at 10:00 am[/b].

Online you will be able to chat with the developer, ask him questions about the game and get answers, and just have fun.

That is the game will not be very long, because the demo is designed for about 10-15 minutes.
The entire stream will last approximately 2 hours.

notes.title: Next Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050604/c29d08f301e703ca15d7d714c0d46d71bba3b1be.png[/img]

Friends, we took part in the festival Steam, come to us, because in the midst of the event we will have a live broadcast with the developers, where you can look at the game, ask questions and just have fun.

Get ready to plunge into the world of permafrost and hopelessness, learn the beginning of Vadim's story and try to just survive...

[previewyoutube=MY9kVyyeSUg;full][/previewyoutube]
At the end of 2021, there was a solar flare of such magnitude that there is now insufficient heat to heat the planet. All electronics malfunctioned, clocks stopped, cars stalled, and an eternal winter of abnormally low temperatures began, causing countless deaths and illnesses. The government had fallen, laws were no longer in effect, and a handful of survivors clung to life at all costs, ready to kill their neighbors for a can of stew or a warm thing.

It took us a long time to get to this point... And now, finally, Survival Instinct demo is ready, and everyone can try it for free on Steam!
The walkthrough duration is 15-20 minutes. This is enough to understand the essence of the game and decide whether to add it to your wishlist or not. We hope you enjoy it and click those two cherished buttons below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050604/ba0ad8aa66e3e99ad53a98bb502ea1cb5d91a079.png[/img]

Don't be frightened by the name of the demo version, the Steam administration messed up something with it. But it's Survival Instinct that's waiting for you inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050604/7942315176ae9b44659c1ee959eb49403caf7f10.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo version coming soon!
Patch 0.0.9 - demo version coming soon
Early stages of development
notes.content:
Greetings! If you haven't followed the project before, it's time to join in! The fun is just beginning😉

We're hard at work on Survival Instinct, our biggest project to date. Previously the development was interrupted to create smaller projects, but now we decided to get down to it and finish it.

While the first documents, the interface and animations for our protagonist are being prepared, here is the first version of the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050604/c83b6b3502744da5c7f6c30690cb759d331b6fe4.png[/img]

Next we touched on the visual and cosmetic elements in the game itself.

The test game location, character, characteristics, and controls are ready. Smooth camera movement and the first objects are 3D effect trees.
Our hero has got an inventory, in which you can place so far only one object - a can of stewed meat, and it is very useful for him, because the game came characteristics that affect the state of the character.

Minor changes again did not pass over the project. The tree collision, character steps and the first prototype interface were changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050604/63fcdd8f8fb33eae53def233292a7aa819ab442c.png[/img]

We then added 18 items to the game, each with its own look, characteristics, and unique description. We updated the inventory and made a character payload indicator and item weights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050604/40fb4a1e6be043be62cb3ea4790cc8f6ded842d6.png[/img]

We don't stop there, development continues, and with it moves everything else, including gameplay and visuals. In brief, numerous changes have been made, now we will tell you about some of them:

[list]
[*] A bottle of water is now available to drink and quench your thirst;
[*] A bandage can be bandaged (just restores health for now);
[*] Increased flight speed of bullets;
[*] Added shaders (color correction, noise, dimming on the edges of the screen);
[*] Day and night system, and flashlight.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050604/29c717c399c1d311e6a36b0ea2e3ce67b9e305a8.png[/img]

Slowly but surely we are approaching the current state of the game.
Grenades, explosions have been added, and a lot of work has been done on the sound effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050604/271544659294db42f895240f160a18e97e61b142.png[/img]

That's all for now.
You can read more about the game in our [url=https://vk.com/wenay_studio]VK group[/url].

Add to wishlist so you don't miss the release!
